parts.text:
Literature check for an optical-lattice theory note. Question: has the following been
solved in the published literature? "Which of the 230 space groups (or 17 wallpaper groups
in 2D) can be realized as the symmetry group of an optical-lattice intensity potential
formed by interfering monochromatic laser beams?" Also: key references on optical
quasicrystals (2D pentagonal / eightfold, icosahedral 3D proposals), and on the criterion
for when a superposition of cosines is periodic vs quasiperiodic (rank of the Fourier
module). Give: (1) verdict OPEN vs SOLVED with citation if solved, (2) the 3-6 most
relevant papers with authors/year/venue, (3) one sentence each on what they showed.
